lead.headline: US companies registered through Bloomberg refuse to name their ultimate owner 5.7% of the time; other registrars, 2.3%
lead.number: Current US global company IDs (LEIs): 5.7% refuse to name the ultimate owner at Bloomberg vs 2.3% at every other registrar; 91% of US refusals sit at Bloomberg.
lead.watch_out: Bloomberg's client mix (swap counterparties, fund vehicles) isn't ruled out, and the harm is unclear.
